profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continuing work on a collection of spring boot micro services, backed by dynamo and postgres. These services are geared toward real time data ingestion and processing in a reliable, event driven manner. Additionally, I also now spend a portion of my time handling code reviews for the junior developers on my team.

Recently have started helping with a new initiative which involves developing a few Spark Scala jobs running on EMR and reading from Cassandra as well as a collection of parquet files.

Designed and built a Redshift Data Warehouse PoC. Built multiple ETL Pipelines from our existing transactional data sources using DMS, Kinesis, and Glue.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing a set of event driven, RESTful, spring boot services. These services leverage RabbitMQ, Aurora Postgres, DynamoDB, Elasticache, and several other technologies. 

Also worked with our dev-ops team on building a CI/CD pipeline which uses Jenkins as well as CloudFormation and ECS to completely automate the entire process of building the code, building the docker image, pushing the image to ECR, and creating/updating the Stack to update the task definition of the service running on ECS. The result is the ability to fully deploy any of our services(from any branch) with a single click, or deploy our entire stack of applications with just a few clicks.

positions.title: Java Cloud Engineer
positions.description: Worked on several Java Spring and Spring Boot web services and REST APIs. Also worked on dockerizing the stack in order to run it locally for development/debugging purposes.

positions.title: Apps. Platform Software Dev. Intern
positions.description:
• Extended the Atlantis system to gather/calculate data/metrics allowing for informed decisions, and key insight.

• Leveraged the ELK stack along with multiple plugins to connect with datadog and sumo logic.

• Exposed a simple test API for the auto-scaling controller to obtain crucial metrics about system status.

• Created a foundation for a kibana extension to manage system components directly from kibana via RPC

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Simplified the HAProxy router configuration workflow by writing a RESTful API that included a CLI

 • Captured extensive log data detailing every aspect of  the requests coming through the router using the HAProxy format.

• Optimized the datastore by replacing ZK with MySQL.

positions.title: OMS Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Monitored important authentication flows using an automated testing framework which was included into the automated build process

• Allowed for constant assurance that new check ins were not creating security risks within the authentication flows.

• Leveraged OpenSAML, Apache HTTPComponents and several other APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Saved countless hours by building an entire customer portal in ASP to automate requesting licenses to the desktop app.

• Optimized and created multiple plugins for the .NET desktop application using the Entity Framework and MEF. Arch.

• Gave managers the ability to remotely manage licenses via an activation webservice which the desktop app would verify itself with.

positions.title: Quality Assurance and Product Development Intern
positions.description: A quick summer internship in between my senior year of high school and freshman year of college. I helped test, debug, and develop multiple ASP.NET websites and worked with their SQL back ends as well as their source control tools. Also, I was able to design and wire frame a proposed mobile application.

positions.title: Database Migration Assistant
positions.description: I was invited to come aid in the migration of their applications SQL database data to a new version of their application which was running on new hardware. I worked mainly on creating/editing SQL scripts in order to shorten and simplify their database creation and configuration.
